metrics.profile_summary: Digital Marketing professional with over 4 years of experience specializing in multi-platform social media management and lead generation. Expert in content strategy, influencer marketing, and coordinating creative teams to enhance brand visibility.

experience.description: Managed US-based Facebook Ads for awareness and lead generation; executed email marketing campaigns via Mailchimp, Campaign Monitor, and Avada.
Handled influencer marketing, Instagram campaign design, caption/hashtag optimization, and community management across social platforms.
Strategized social media campaigns, created consistent content to boost engagement, and conducted research to improve online presence.

strengths: Extensive experience across all required social platforms
Proven ability to lead designers and content writers
Strong background in both organic and paid social strategies
weaknesses: Bachelor's degree is in History rather than Marketing/Communications
No explicit mention of UTM tracking or Microsoft Excel
evaluation.summary: The candidate is highly qualified with over 4 years of direct experience in social media management and content coordination, exceeding the minimum requirements.
